parameters.specification/query:
DEFINE
    // MONDAY TO SUNDAY WEEK: Notice both use 'WEEKDAY(..., 2)' to be consistent.
    VAR __StartOfLastWeek = TODAY() - WEEKDAY(TODAY(), 2) - 6
    VAR __EndOfLastWeek   = TODAY() - WEEKDAY(TODAY(), 2)

    VAR __RawData = 
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'Cases'[Repair Order Number],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Line Status],
            'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date],
            'Date - Ship Date'[Ship Date],
            'Date - Due Date'[Due Date],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number In],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number In],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number Out],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number Out],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Problem Description],
            'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[OTD],
            'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Ship To Address],
            'Ship To Site'[City],
            'Ship To Site'[Shipping Country],
            'Repair Order Lines'[Outbound Tracking Number],
            'Ship To Site'[Store Number],
            'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[End Customer Name],
            
            // Filters
            TREATAS({"NKD"}, 'MLM contracts'[MLM Customer]),
            FILTER(
                ALL('Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date]),
                'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date] >= __StartOfLastWeek &&
                'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date] <= __EndOfLastWeek
            ),
            
        
            "__RecordCount", COUNTROWS('Repair Order Lines')
        )

    VAR __ResultTable = 
        SELECTCOLUMNS(
            __RawData,
            "'Cases'[Repair Order Number]", 'Cases'[Repair Order Number],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Line Status]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Line Status],
            "'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date]", 'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date],
            "'Date - Ship Date'[Ship Date]", 'Date - Ship Date'[Ship Date],
            "'Date - Due Date'[Due Date]", 'Date - Due Date'[Due Date],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number In]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number In],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number In]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number In],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number Out]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number Out],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number Out]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number Out],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Problem Description]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Problem Description],
            "'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[OTD]", 'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[OTD],
            "'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type]", 'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Ship To Address]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Ship To Address],
            "'Ship To Site'[City]", 'Ship To Site'[City],
            "'Ship To Site'[Shipping Country]", 'Ship To Site'[Shipping Country],
            "'Repair Order Lines'[Outbound Tracking Number]", 'Repair Order Lines'[Outbound Tracking Number],
            "'Ship To Site'[Store Number]", 'Ship To Site'[Store Number],
            "'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[End Customer Name]", 'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[End Customer Name]
        )

EVALUATE
    __ResultTable

ORDER BY
    'Cases'[Repair Order Number],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Line Status],
    'Date - Repair Created Date'[Repair Created Date],
    'Date - Ship Date'[Ship Date],
    'Date - Due Date'[Due Date],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number In],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number In],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Serial Number Out],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Product Number Out],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Problem Description],
    'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[OTD],
    'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[Fault Type],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Ship To Address],
    'Ship To Site'[City],
    'Ship To Site'[Shipping Country],
    'Repair Order Lines'[Outbound Tracking Number],
    'Ship To Site'[Store Number],
    'Repair Order Lines Reporting Fields'[End Customer Name]
